'''''Show Girls''''' was an [[Painting/Legends|advertisement]] for the [[Show Girls/Legends|stage entertainment show]] of the same name active during the [[Clone Wars]]. The ad was featured on [[Hover taxi/Legends|hover taxi]] screens and put up as [[Painting/Legends|posters]] in [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. It showed a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dressed in a [[Huttese slave-girl costume|slave-girl costume]], posing seductively against a [[Color/Legends|red]] and white background, with the name of the show printed in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] at the bottom.<ref name="Lethal" />
